config.name: feedback_p25_bp
config.training_objective: local adversarial handoff with optional single-write feedback and D auxiliaries
config.state_diagnostic_note: whole-memory norms/saturation include raw coordinates when recent_points > 0
config.particle_policy: one fixed z per real episode, shared across sampled positions
config.feedback_gradient: two G evaluations connected through frozen D writer in G phase; detached proposal in D phase
config.feedback_target: original next real point as recovery target
config.memory_timing: strictly before target, optional replacement of last observation; same M for real/fake scoring
config.penalty_domain: candidate coordinates only; same cached memory; exact default B-cap
